source_contract.B_orientation: a^T B v = vx*ay-vy*ax = planar cross(v,a)

protocol.candidate_selection: per trial/phase: initial, last accepted, max accepted wheel-ratio; deduplicated
protocol.point_selection: four diagnostic wheel peaks plus minimum actual primary/dense objective node
protocol.coverage: minimum speeds at actual primary and triggered dense nodes for every saved canonical candidate
protocol.finite_difference: two-point centered and five-point centered with opposite-sample pairing, three prespecified steps
protocol.clamp_boundary: exact 1e-4 velocity norm is nondifferentiable; do not label analytic mismatch as a smooth-point failure
protocol.time_chain: primary quadrature with frozen coefficients; not a complete native MINCO gradient test
protocol.no_improvement_claim: numerical consistency audit only; no trajectory-delivery or solver improvement claim

limitations: The tested cost includes linear-speed, wheel-speed/acceleration and optional minimum-speed penalties.
Physical wheel-model correctness and native vs final-check sampling differences are not established by finite differences.
Full MINCO gradient/backpropagation, dense-trigger time chain, map and collision gradients are outside this audit.
Synthetic low-speed defects are not causal evidence for captured requests unless the captured objective visits that region.
Historical candidate native/posterior audits do not certify future online state/map admission.

infrastructure_recheck.reason: opposite-pair five-point FD arithmetic avoids large-constant cancellation
